run_job_runner_loop: run the JobRunner main loop to process pending submissions for a competition
get_pending_submissions: get pending submissions from the competition dataset repo as a sorted DataFrame
run_local_evaluation: run a local evaluation for a team submission using the competition parameters
create_hf_space_for_submission: create a Hugging Face space with Dockerfile and params secret for a script submission
mark_submission_failed: mark a team submission as failed by updating its status in the dataset repo
